claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 uM for 5 days, this TRPV1 antagonist is expected to be largely inactive as a cytotoxic agent, since TRPV1 antagonism does not directly kill cancer cells and no dominant off-target cytotoxicity is evident at this concentration.
